table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname= item.name,  
	itemaliasname=item.customicode,
	recipient = Case RecipientCode When 1 Then (Select Name From Department Where DeptCode=issueheader.deptcode) When 2 Then (Select Name From Accounts Where AccCode = issueheader.AccCode) When 3 Then (Select Name From Accounts Where AccCode = issueheader.AccCode) When 4 Then (Select Name From SalesMan Where SalesManCode = issueheader.RecipientSalesMan ) End,
	salesman = dbo.users.username, 
	issueinvcode = dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode, 
	smanname=(SELECT salesman.name FROM SalesMan WHERE SalesMan.SalesManCode = IssueHeader.SMANCode),
	date = dbo.issueheader.date,
	price = issuedetail.price,
	dbo.issueheader.deptcode,
	dbo.issueheader.remarks,	
	gcode = issuedetail.gcode,   
	icode = issuedetail.icode,   
	batch = issuedetail.batch,   
	expiry = issuedetail.expiry,   
	looseqty = issuedetail.qty,
	referenceno=ISNULL((select name from issuetype where issuetypecode = issueheader.issuetypecode), '') + CASE issueheader.issuetypecode WHEN NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' END + dbo.issueheader.referenceno,
	dbo.issueheader.referencedate,
	Godown = Godown.name,
	itempacking = itempacking.name,
	Id       = dbo.issuedetail.IDENTITYCOL 
	
FROM 
	issueheader, 
	issuedetail, 
	users, 
	item 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Godown ON (dbo.item.gcode = dbo.Godown.gcode)	
WHERE 
	( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = :ar_issueInvCode ) AND
	( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = dbo.issuedetail.issueinvcode) AND
	( dbo.issueheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND 
	( dbo.issuedetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)

ORDER BY 
	dbo.issuedetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: Round ( Sum ( Round ( price * qty , 2 ) for all ) , 0 )
